description: Four low pass gates modelled on the one in the Buchla Easel. Each works as a VCA, as a low pass filter, or as both together, and every instance comes out a little different

params.text: How far that gate is open with no voltage at its mod input
How much of the voltage at that gate's mod input opens it
The resonance of that gate's low pass filter; fully anticlockwise matches the original
Steps that gate through its three modes, shown by its two lamps: a VCA alone, a low pass filter alone, and the two together

menu: Vactrol FAST, Vactrol NORMAL and Vactrol SLOW — set how quickly one gate's vactrol answers a change, under a heading naming that gate: LPG A, LPG B, LPG C or LPG D
Non linear mode — gives one gate a non-linear response, under the heading naming that gate
